entity_raw.definition_raw: Aristocracy SubdomainSource Champions of Balance pg. 16Associated Domain(s): NobilityAssociated Deities: Abadar, NalinivatiReplacement Power: The following granted power replaces the inspiring word ability of the Nobility domain. Noble Visage (Su): You gain a +1 bonus on Charisma checks and Charisma-based skill checks against creatures that share your creature type (and subtype, if you are a humanoid). This bonus increases by 1 for every 5 levels you possess. As a standard action, you can touch an ally to grant her your noble visage bonus against creatures that share her creature type (or subtype) for 1 minute. When you use this ability, you lose your noble visage bonus for 1 minute. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.Replacement Domain Spells: 3rd—enter image, 9th—overwhelming presence.
